sites.ownership: Runtime icon setup owns the developer-only icon directory guard.
sites.justification: This probe only runs for the explicit RITEED_DEV_ICON_DIR development override during startup and is not used for project, document, portal, or user-selected paths.

sites.ownership: Source Control native live refresh owns the Git index-lock probe.
sites.justification: The scheduler disables this probe for portal and polling contexts; native index-lock deferral is a UI-jank optimization because git status tolerates concurrent index writes.

sites.ownership: Source Control native metadata monitoring owns target existence probing.
sites.justification: Metadata targets are only resolved on native non-polling Git contexts; portal and non-native paths return before monitor target discovery.

sites.ownership: Source Control native metadata monitoring owns target kind probing.
sites.justification: Directory/file classification is only used to choose a native Gio monitor after portal paths have selected polling.

sites.ownership: Source Control native metadata monitoring owns nearest-parent probing.
sites.justification: Nearest existing parent discovery is only used for native Git metadata monitor installation and is skipped for portal/polling contexts.
